citations.claim: body centre at x~8.99 y=6 overlaps wall corner by 0.1998 exceeding 0.15 limit
one step earlier overlap was 0.1407 within limit, showing penetration grew through the corner contact
body was driven at ~20 m/s toward the wall before impact

explanation: Controller drives body at ~20 m/s (vcmd) directly at the top corner of wall (top at y=5.7, body at y=6). On corner contact the impulse plus positional correction fails to keep overlap bounded under continuous driving force (~37.7 N), so penetration grows from 0.14 at step 39 to 0.1998 at step 40, exceeding the 0.15 no_wall_penetration tolerance.
vision_note: The red body moves right toward the green waypoint and contacts the top-left corner of the tall grey wall. By step 40 it stays lodged overlapping the corner instead of sliding over it or being pushed clear.
